The evidence indicates that Linagliptin, as part of the DPP4 inhibitor class, may exert its effects by targeting DPP4, similar to Sitagliptin. The lowest common ancestor relationship between Linagliptin and Sitagliptin, along with the direct binding of Sitagliptin to DPP4, implies that Linagliptin might also interact with DPP4 via a similar mechanism. This integration of classification and functional evidence supports the hypothesis that Linagliptin could act on DPP4, although the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated.
